visual_discovery_basis.chart_window: 126 sessions before through 126 sessions after signal
visual_discovery_basis.economic_observation: pre-entry shapes overlap materially; profitable events usually reach frozen zone upper boundary quickly, while large losses commonly lose the frozen lower boundary after entry and continue lower

baseline.entry: first legal next open no later than signal_idx+3
baseline.target: frozen zone_u, recognized only on a legal state
baseline.time_stop: after 20 calendar indices, next legal sellable open

compressed_rules.definition: the first otherwise legal entry open must be greater than or equal to the frozen pre-existing zone_l; otherwise do not enter
compressed_rules.economic_claim: a gap back below zone_l before entry means the re-entry/acceptance thesis is already invalid

compressed_rules.definition: after entry and before target, the first legal daily close strictly below frozen zone_l arms an exit at the next legal sellable open; an intraday zone_u target reached on that same day has priority because it occurs before the close is known
compressed_rules.economic_claim: loss of the accepted supply-zone boundary indicates that trapped supply remains dominant

market_state.definition: on each signal date, compute the median ret60 across the broad PIT-valid, current-day-tradable, non-ST A-share cross-section
market_state.use_in_round_1: diagnostic stratification only; not an admission filter and not exposure scaling

state_anatomy: same metrics within frozen bull and bear states
evaluation.user_gate: at least 50 completed signals in every development year and mean net return above 4% in every development year before opening 2022-2024 signal outcomes
